about.content:
Harry Dong is a master's student (2024-entry) in the School of Computer Science, Nanjing Audit University.

His research interests include federated learning, federated graph learning, edge computing, and privacy-preserving machine learning. His current research focuses on data heterogeneity, noise robustness, communication efficiency, and edge deployment in federated learning under complex and heterogeneous environments.

He currently presides over one Jiangsu Provincial Postgraduate Research and Practice Innovation Program. He has published one academic paper, with another paper under external review. He has publicly disclosed two invention patents, with one additional patent under acceptance. He has won three provincial-level and above awards.

In terms of engineering practice, he has more than half a year of front-end development experience and is proficient in the Vue framework. In the summer of 2025, he interned at the Beijing headquarters of COFCO Group as a Big Data Analyst, solidifying his capabilities in data analysis, data processing and practical project implementation.
